name: Suzushiro Sumire
source:
The main character with a somewhat sunken expression. Although she has stopped interacting with people and is depressed, she finds her current job rewarding and cherishes it. She doesn't interfere too much and prefers to observe quietly. She likes sleeping and looking at churches.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211229112616/https://blessing-string.com/]official website[/url]]
